If you need to cancel a PhotoRequest, you can send a DELETE request for the PhotoRequest ID.
If it's 'unassigned' we will cancel the Photo Request and a successful reponse will be returned.
If your Photo Request status isn't 'unassigned', our support team will be notified about your cancelation request
and we'll work to cancel the Photo Request for you.

If the photo request has been assigned or is in another status, the cancellation request will be escalated to the ProxyPics support team for manual review and processing. Returns the updated photo request object with canceled status.

data.current_description:
When a request is in `expired` state and you want to make it available again you can call the Extend.

It'll behave slightly different whether the Photo Request is for Crowdsource or it is for Direct.

When it is for Crowdsource, the `expires_at` date will be updated to the parameter you passed and the request will be `unassigned`,
meaning that it is avalable for photo takers to pick it up again.

When it is for Direct, the assignment `expires_at` will be updated to the parameter you passed, the request will `assigned`
and the assignment will be back to `pending` state, meaning that the photo taker firstly assigned to it will still be able to submit it.
data.description_suggestion: Extend an expired photo request to make it available again. Behavior differs by platform: For Crowdsource requests, updates the `expires_at` date and sets status to `unassigned` so photo takers can pick it up again. For Direct requests, updates the assignment `expires_at` date, maintains `assigned` status, and resets the assignment to `pending` state so the originally assigned photo taker can still complete it. Returns the updated photo request object with new expiration details.
data.reasoning: Summary is clear and action-oriented. Description explains platform-specific behavior well but lacks explicit information about the return value. Added explicit statement about what is returned to improve AI agent understanding of operation effects.
